The MSI Cubi 5 Mini PC is a compact yet powerful computing solution designed for space-conscious users who need reliable performance. This model features an Intel Core i3-1215U processor from the 12th generation, providing efficient performance for everyday tasks, light content creation, and office applications. The system supports up to 64GB of RAM, ensuring smooth multitasking and handling of memory-intensive applications. The storage configuration can be customized with either HDD or SSD options, with an automatic switching feature that optimizes performance based on the installed drive type. The inclusion of Thunderbolt 4 connectivity via USB Type-C allows for high-speed data transfer and connection to external displays or peripherals. The Ultra 4K HD HDMI port supports high-resolution external displays for presentations or media consumption. The mini PC's compact form factor makes it ideal for small offices, home setups, or as a secondary machine in larger computing environments. The system includes Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.2 for wireless connectivity options.

Intel Core i5-13400F RTX 5050 Gaming PC – 16GB RAM, 500GB NVMe SSD

 Powerful 1080p Gaming PC with Intel and NVIDIA Performance

 The Intel Core i5-13400F RTX 5050 Gaming PC is built for gamers who want strong daily performance, smooth 1080p gaming, fast loading times, and a clean ARGB gaming look. This PC combines a modern Intel 13th Gen processor, a Palit GeForce RTX 5050 Dual 8GB graphics card, 16GB dual-channel DDR4 memory, and fast NVMe storage to deliver a balanced experience for gaming, multitasking, studying, office work, and entertainment.

 Processor Performance

 Intel Core i5-13400F – 10 Cores and 16 Threads

 At the heart of this system is the Intel Core i5-13400F , a 13th Generation processor designed with Intel hybrid architecture. It features 10 cores , including 6 Performance-cores and 4 Efficient-cores , with a total of 16 threads . This gives the PC strong performance for modern games, background applications, browsing, Discord, launchers, and productivity tasks.

 The processor can reach up to 4.60GHz Max Turbo Frequency and includes 20MB Intel Smart Cache , making it a powerful and reliable choice for a gaming PC in this category. Because this is an F-series processor , it does not include integrated graphics, which makes it ideal for builds that use a dedicated graphics card like the RTX 5050.

 Graphics Card

 Palit GeForce RTX 5050 Dual 8GB

 Graphics performance is powered by the Palit GeForce RTX 5050 Dual 8GB GDDR6 . This GPU is designed for modern 1080p gaming, offering NVIDIA RTX technologies, AI-powered graphics features, and support for modern display standards. The Palit RTX 5050 Dual comes with 8GB GDDR6 memory , 2560 CUDA cores , a 128-bit memory interface , and modern outputs including HDMI and DisplayPort.

 Dual-Fan Cooling Design

 The Palit Dual cooling design uses a compact dual-fan layout to help keep the graphics card cool during gaming sessions. Its clean black design, dual-slot size, and efficient cooling structure make it suitable for gaming systems where airflow, space, and reliability matter.

 Motherboard

 ASUS PRIME H610M-K D4

 The system is built on the ASUS PRIME H610M-K D4 , a micro-ATX motherboard using the Intel H610 chipset and LGA1700 socket . It supports Intel 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen processors, DDR4 memory, PCIe 4.0 for the graphics card, M.2 storage, SATA storage, Realtek Ethernet, USB connectivity, and essential ASUS protection features.

 Stable ASUS Protection Features

 ASUS PRIME motherboards are designed for stability and everyday reliability. This board includes practical protection and durability features such as ASUS 5X Protection III, DIGI+ VRM control, LANGuard, and SafeSlot Core, helping improve long-term system stability for gaming and daily use.

 Memory and Storage

 16GB Lexar THOR DDR4 RAM

 This PC includes 16GB Lexar THOR DDR4 RAM , installed as 2x8GB for dual-channel performance. Dual-channel memory helps improve system responsiveness and gaming performance compared to single-stick configurations. Lexar THOR DDR4 memory supports Intel XMP 2.0 and uses an aluminum heat spreader designed to help with airflow and heat dissipation.

 The RAM kit is listed as 3600MHz . However, because the ASUS PRIME H610M-K D4 officially supports DDR4 memory up to 3200MHz, the actual running speed may depend on BIOS settings, CPU memory controller support, and compatibility.

 Kingston NV3 500GB NVMe SSD

 Storage is handled by the Kingston NV3 500GB NVMe SSD , a fast PCIe NVMe drive designed for quick Windows boot times, faster game loading, and smoother everyday use. Compared to traditional hard drives, NVMe storage gives the system a much faster and more responsive feel when opening applications, launching games, transferring files, and using Windows.

Intel Core i5-13400F RTX 5060 Gaming PC – 16GB RAM, 500GB NVMe SSD

 Powerful Gaming PC with Intel Core i5 and ASUS RTX 5060 Performance

 The Intel Core i5-13400F RTX 5060 Gaming PC is a strong and balanced desktop build designed for smooth 1080p gaming, fast daily performance, modern graphics features, and a clean ARGB gaming look. This system combines the power of a 13th Generation Intel Core processor with an ASUS GeForce RTX 5060 8GB graphics card, 16GB dual-channel DDR4 memory, fast Kingston NV3 NVMe storage, efficient DeepCool CPU cooling, and a stylish Thermaltake ARGB case with 5 fans.

 This gaming PC is ideal for esports titles, modern online games, school work, office tasks, browsing, streaming, and everyday multitasking. It is built for users who want a reliable ready-to-use gaming system with trusted components from Intel, ASUS, Lexar, Kingston, Thermalright, DeepCool, and Thermaltake.

 Processor Performance

 Intel Core i5-13400F – 10 Cores and 16 Threads

 At the heart of this build is the Intel Core i5-13400F , a 13th Generation desktop processor designed with Intel hybrid architecture. It features 10 cores , including 6 Performance-cores and 4 Efficient-cores , with a total of 16 threads . This structure helps the PC handle gaming, background applications, browsers, launchers, Discord, and productivity software smoothly.

 The Intel Core i5-13400F can reach up to 4.60GHz Max Turbo Frequency and includes 20MB Intel Smart Cache . Because this is an F-series processor , it does not include integrated graphics, making it a suitable choice for a gaming PC that uses a dedicated graphics card such as the ASUS RTX 5060.

 Graphics Card

 ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5060 OC Edition 8GB GDDR7

 Graphics performance is powered by the ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5060 OC Edition 8GB GDDR7 . This graphics card is designed for modern gaming performance with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 Series technology. It features 3840 CUDA cores , 8GB GDDR7 memory , a 128-bit memory interface , and memory speed up to 28Gbps .

 The ASUS RTX 5060 supports modern display connectivity with 1x HDMI 2.1b and 3x DisplayPort 2.1b , with support for up to 4 displays . It is also built for modern high-resolution output, with digital maximum resolution support up to 7680 x 4320 .

 The ASUS Dual RTX 5060 uses a compact cooling design with two Axial-tech fans and a 2.5-slot design . This helps improve airflow and cooling efficiency while keeping the card suitable for many gaming cases. The card also includes ASUS 0dB technology, allowing quieter operation under lighter workloads.

 The motherboard supports DDR4 memory, includes one PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for the graphics card, one M.2 slot for NVMe storage, four SATA 6Gb/s ports, Realtek 1Gb Ethernet, HDMI, D-Sub, USB 3.2 Gen 1, USB 2.0, and Realtek audio. It is a practical and reliable motherboard choice for a clean budget-friendly gaming build.

 ASUS Reliability Features

 ASUS PRIME motherboards include useful durability and stability features such as ASUS 5X Protection III, DIGI+ VRM, LANGuard, and SafeSlot Core. These features help improve long-term reliability for gaming, daily work, and regular PC use.

 ASUS PRIME H610M-K Motherboard

 Intel H610 and LGA1700 Platform

 ASUS specifies the PRIME H610M-K platform with PCIe 4.0 graphics connectivity, an M.2 storage slot, Realtek Gigabit Ethernet, USB 3.2 Gen 1 and SATA 6Gb/s connectivity. ASUS also lists support for compatible 12th, 13th and 14th Generation Intel Core processors.

 ASUS sells multiple H610M-K variants with different memory configurations, so this listing does not state a motherboard memory generation unless the exact installed revision is confirmed.

 16GB HIKSEMI ARMOR Gaming RAM

 Reliable Memory for Gaming and Multitasking

whiteangel-pemdou.description:
AMD Ryzen7 7700 RTX 5060 Ti 8GB Gaming PC in Jordan

 The Ryzen7 7700 RTX 5060 Ti Gaming PC is a powerful AMD AM5 gaming desktop built for gamers who want stronger graphics performance, an 8-core Ryzen processor, high-speed DDR5 memory, fast PCIe 4.0 NVMe storage, Wi-Fi 7 connectivity and a modern upgrade-friendly platform.

 This configuration combines the AMD Ryzen7 7700 processor , PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB EPIC-X RGB Overclocked Triple Fan graphics card , MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI motherboard , 16GB G.SKILL DDR5 6000 memory , Kingston NV3 1TB NVMe SSD , Thermaltake Smart BM3 Bronze 750W power supply , DeepCool AG400 PLUS CPU cooler , and a Huntkey G35 gaming case configured with three RGB fans .

 Ryzen7 7700 RTX 5060 Ti Gaming Performance

 AMD Ryzen 7 7700 Zen 4 Processor

 At the heart of this Gaming PC is the AMD Ryzen7 7700 , a Ryzen 7000 Series desktop processor based on AMD’s Zen 4 architecture .

 AMD officially specifies the Ryzen 7 7700 with 8 CPU cores and 16 threads , a base clock of 3.8GHz , and a maximum boost clock of up to 5.3GHz . It includes 32MB of L3 cache , 8MB of L2 cache and has a default TDP of only 65W .

 The processor uses AMD’s AM5 socket , supports AMD EXPO memory technology, Precision Boost Overdrive and Ryzen Master, and AMD officially lists B850 among its supported chipsets. It also includes basic integrated AMD Radeon Graphics, although gaming performance in this system is handled by the dedicated RTX 5060 Ti.

 PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB OC Triple Fan

 EPIC-X RGB Factory-Overclocked Graphics

 Graphics performance comes from the PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB EPIC-X RGB Overclocked Triple Fan , exact SKU VCG5060T8TFXXPB1-O .

 PNY officially specifies this card with 4,608 CUDA cores , 8GB GDDR7 memory , a 128-bit memory interface , 28Gbps memory speed and 448GB/s memory bandwidth . The GPU runs at a 2407MHz base clock and reaches a factory-overclocked 2692MHz boost clock .

 Maximum graphics power is rated at 180W , and the card uses a single 8-pin power connector . PNY recommends a 600W system power supply , while this Gaming PC uses a 750W Thermaltake unit.

 The card measures approximately 299 × 120 × 40mm and uses a two-slot triple-fan cooling design. It also provides three DisplayPort 2.1b outputs and one HDMI 2.1b output.

 The RTX 5060 Ti uses NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and supports current-generation GeForce technologies including DLSS, ray tracing and NVIDIA Reflex in compatible titles. Actual FPS will always vary depending on game, resolution, settings, drivers and updates.

 MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI Motherboard

 AM5, Wi-Fi 7, 5G LAN and PCIe 5.0

 The system is built around the MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI , a modern mATX motherboard using AMD’s B850 chipset and AM5 socket.

 MSI officially lists support for AMD Ryzen 7000, 8000 and 9000 Series processors , making it directly compatible with the Ryzen 7 7700.

 The motherboard provides four DDR5 DIMM slots , dual-channel memory operation and AMD EXPO support. MSI lists memory-overclocking support extending up to 8200+ MT/s in supported configurations, so DDR5-6000 falls comfortably within the motherboard’s capabilities.

 Storage expansion is particularly strong, with three M.2 slots . The primary slot supports up to PCIe 5.0 x4 , while the remaining slots provide additional NVMe expansion options.

 Networking is another major feature: MSI includes 5Gb Ethernet, Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4 . With a Ryzen 7000 processor installed, the primary graphics slot can operate at PCIe 5.0 x16.

 16GB G.SKILL DDR5 6000 RAM

 High-Speed DDR5 Memory

 This Gaming PC includes 16GB of G.SKILL DDR5 memory rated at 6000MT/s .

 G.SKILL officially offers 16GB DDR5-6000 modules and kits designed for modern DDR5 systems, including AMD-compatible products featuring EXPO profiles. G.SKILL notes that reaching the advertised DDR5-6000 speed requires compatible hardware and the appropriate BIOS memory profile.

AMD Ryzen 7 7700 RTX 5070 12GB Gaming PC in Jordan

 The Ryzen 7 7700 RTX 5070 Gaming PC is a powerful AMD AM5 gaming desktop designed for users who want strong processor performance, modern NVIDIA Blackwell graphics, DDR5 memory, fast PCIe 4.0 NVMe storage, Wi-Fi 6E connectivity and a high-quality 80 PLUS Gold power supply.

 This configuration combines the AMD Ryzen 7 7700 processor , ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GDDR7 graphics card , GIGABYTE B650E EAGLE WIFI6E motherboard , 16GB G.SKILL DDR5 6000 memory , Kingston NV3 1TB NVMe SSD , MSI MAG A750GL PCIE5 750W 80 PLUS Gold power supply , MSI MAG CORELIQUID A13 240 liquid cooler , and a Thermaltake MH1 Full Glass case configured with seven fans .

 The result is a modern gaming platform suitable for demanding PC games, multitasking, productivity, study, entertainment and everyday high-performance use.

 Ryzen 7 7700 RTX 5070 Gaming Performance

 AMD Ryzen 7 7700 Zen 4 Processor

 At the heart of this Gaming PC is the AMD Ryzen 7 7700 , a Ryzen 7000 Series desktop processor based on AMD’s Zen 4 architecture.

 AMD officially specifies the Ryzen 7 7700 with 8 CPU cores and 16 threads , a base clock of 3.8GHz , and a maximum boost clock of up to 5.3GHz . It includes 32MB of L3 cache , 8MB of L2 cache and operates with a default TDP of only 65W .

 The processor uses AMD’s AM5 socket and supports technologies including AMD EXPO memory overclocking, Precision Boost Overdrive and Ryzen Master. AMD also lists B650/B650E-class platforms among the supported chipsets for the Ryzen 7 7700.

 The Ryzen 7 7700 also includes basic integrated AMD Radeon Graphics, although the dedicated RTX 5070 is used for gaming and GPU-intensive workloads in this configuration.

 ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5070 12GB

 Triple-Fan NVIDIA Blackwell Graphics

 Graphics performance is provided by the ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GDDR7 , exact model PRIME-RTX5070-12G .

 This is the standard Prime version rather than the separately sold PRIME-RTX5070-O12G OC Edition.

 ASUS officially specifies 6,144 CUDA cores , 12GB of GDDR7 memory , a 192-bit memory interface , and memory speed of 28Gbps . The standard card has a default Boost Clock of 2512MHz , while ASUS GPU Tweak III can offer an optional 2542MHz OC Mode profile.

 The ASUS Prime RTX 5070 uses a triple-fan cooling design , measures 304 × 126 × 50mm , occupies 2.5 slots and uses one 16-pin power connector . ASUS recommends a 750W PSU , which directly matches the 750W MSI power supply used in this Gaming PC.

 The RTX 5070 is based on NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and supports modern GeForce technologies including DLSS, hardware-accelerated ray tracing and NVIDIA Reflex in compatible titles. Actual FPS varies according to the game, resolution, quality settings, drivers and software version.

 GIGABYTE B650E EAGLE WIFI6E Motherboard

 AM5, DDR5, PCIe 5.0 and Wi-Fi 6E

 GIGABYTE officially lists support for AMD Ryzen 7000, 8000 and 9000 Series processors , making the motherboard compatible with the Ryzen 7 7700.

 The motherboard provides four DDR5 DIMM slots with dual-channel memory architecture and supports memory speeds including DDR5-6000 as an overclocked configuration . Both AMD EXPO and Intel XMP memory profiles are supported on compatible modules.

 With a Ryzen 7000 processor installed, its primary graphics slot supports PCIe 5.0 x16 , giving the system a modern expansion platform. Networking includes Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet , while wireless connectivity is provided through Wi-Fi 6E supporting the 2.4GHz, 5GHz and 6GHz bands, together with Bluetooth 5.3 according to the current official specification.

whiteangel-1lbpagj.description:
Intel Core i9-14900KF RTX 5070 12GB Gaming PC in Jordan

 The i9-14900KF RTX 5070 Gaming PC is a premium high-performance desktop designed for gamers and demanding users who want flagship Intel processing power, modern NVIDIA Blackwell graphics, DDR5 memory and fast PCIe 4.0 NVMe storage.

 This configuration combines the Intel Core i9-14900KF , ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GDDR7 , MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI motherboard , 32GB G.SKILL DDR5 6000 memory , Kingston NV3 1TB NVMe SSD , MSI MPG A850GS PCIE5 850W 80 PLUS Gold power supply , DeepCool LE720 360mm ARGB liquid cooler , and the Thermaltake MH1 Full Glass chassis with seven fans .

 The result is a powerful platform suitable for modern gaming, heavy multitasking, streaming, productivity, creative workloads and demanding everyday PC use.

 i9-14900KF RTX 5070 Gaming Performance

 Intel Core i9-14900KF Processor

 At the heart of this Gaming PC is the Intel Core i9-14900KF , a 14th Generation Intel Core desktop processor.

 Intel officially specifies the i9-14900KF with 24 total cores and 32 threads , consisting of 8 Performance-cores and 16 Efficient-cores . The processor can reach a maximum turbo frequency of 6.0GHz and includes 36MB of Intel Smart Cache . It uses the LGA1700 socket and supports DDR5 memory up to 5600 MT/s at Intel’s standard specification level.

 The i9-14900KF carries a 125W processor base power specification and is designed for high-performance desktop workloads. Because this is a KF-series processor , it does not include integrated processor graphics, so graphics output is handled by the dedicated RTX 5070.

 With 24 cores and 32 threads, this processor gives the system substantial resources for gaming while also handling streaming applications, browser tabs, productivity software and demanding multitasking.

 ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 12GB

 Triple-Fan NVIDIA Blackwell Graphics

 Graphics performance is provided by the ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GDDR7 , standard model TUF-RTX5070-12G-GAMING .

 ASUS officially specifies 6,144 CUDA cores , 12GB GDDR7 memory , a 192-bit memory interface and 28Gbps memory speed. The standard model has a default Boost Clock of 2512MHz , while ASUS GPU Tweak III provides an optional 2542MHz OC Mode profile.

 The TUF card uses a large triple-fan design , measures 329 × 140 × 62.5mm , occupies approximately 3.125 slots and uses a single 16-pin power connector. ASUS recommends a 750W PSU for this card.

 This build uses an 850W Gold-rated MSI PSU, providing additional rated capacity above ASUS’s recommendation.

 The RTX 5070 platform supports current NVIDIA RTX technologies including DLSS, ray tracing and NVIDIA Reflex in compatible games and applications. Actual FPS will always vary according to resolution, graphics settings, driver version and individual game.

 MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI Motherboard

 Z790 DDR5 Platform with PCIe 5.0

 The system is built on the MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI , an ATX motherboard based on Intel’s Z790 chipset and LGA1700 socket.

 MSI officially supports compatible 12th, 13th and 14th Generation Intel Core processors , making this motherboard fully compatible with the i9-14900KF.

 The board features four DDR5 DIMM slots with capacity up to 256GB . MSI officially lists DDR5-6000 as a supported overclocked memory speed and supports Intel XMP 3.0 , making it an appropriate platform for the G.SKILL DDR5-6000 memory used in this system.

 For graphics expansion, the main PCIe slot supports PCIe 5.0 x16 directly from the CPU.

 Storage expansion is particularly strong, with four M.2 slots supporting PCIe 4.0 x4 drives plus six SATA 6Gb/s connectors. This gives plenty of room for future SSD upgrades beyond the installed Kingston NV3.

 Networking includes Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet, Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 , providing both fast wired and wireless connectivity.

 32GB G.SKILL DDR5 6000 RAM

 High-Speed DDR5 Memory

 This Gaming PC includes 32GB of G.SKILL DDR5 memory rated at 6000 MT/s .
